title: Sharp mean-width and Jacobian bounds for Euclidean and hyperbolic harmonic maps
summary: We prove a sharp mean-width inequality for monotone zonal operators and derive global and differential bounds for Euclidean and hyperbolic-harmonic self-maps of the unit ball.
